scope: Bounded supplemental primary-source review; earlier industrial source register remains applicable.

sources.coverage: Abstract, performance definitions, discussion and conclusion. Institutional PDF resolves the earlier publisher-access failure for this comparison.
sources.supports: Laboratory operation with bottled O2/H2; reported best point at H:O mass ratio 1:25 has 2130 s anode Isp and 10.1% total efficiency. Neither 2000 s on all supplied water nor 30-50% bus-to-jet efficiency is demonstrated.
Ground 125000-litre hydrogen tank with 390 W cooling at 20 K, and over 13 months of testing. No claim of a flight-qualified million-tonne orbital depot or demonstrated model cooling specific power.

sources.coverage: Indexed qualification-goal passage; not a complete presentation review.
sources.supports: 12 kW AEPS qualification target of 23000 powered hours. This is a xenon-system goal, not demonstrated water-thruster life; used only as a prospective replaceable-module target.

Electric LEO-to-lunar trajectories require departure, eccentric-orbit and lunar-arrival design. The present 6-10 km/s Earth-leg range is an engineering bracket, not a value fitted to this source or a solved trajectory.

price_basis: All new component and lifetime prices are explicit future engineering assumptions in 2026 purchasing power; no supplier bid or market-price validation.
